replaces.idea: A floor-mounted telecom patchbay cabinet with jack sockets and draped patch cords bridging inputs to outputs.
A rotating metal carousel stand on a pedestal base with clip-on descriptor cards hanging around its rim.
A wall-mounted pigeonhole cubby box with slot openings holding protruding register key-cards.
A compact PCIe card-edge ejector latch mounted on a bracket with a hooked lever arm.
A desk-mounted brass telegraph tapper on a plinth that sends interrupt pulses when pressed.
A mechanical tally clicker on a base with a thumb plunger and a 3-digit credit drum window.
A standing customs tollbooth with a striped barrier arm that translates and gates DMA traffic.

new.name: IOMMU Tollbooth
new.concept: IOMMU (DMA address translation and memory isolation)
new.depicts: A standing customs tollbooth on a flat base, with a striped barrier arm raised on the right and a small inspection window on the front.

new.name: Descriptor Carousel
new.depicts: A rotating metal carousel stand on a pedestal base, with evenly spaced clip-on ticket cards hanging around its rim.
new.focal: The ring of hanging ticket cards

new.name: Fabric Patchbay
new.depicts: A standing floor-mounted telecom patchbay cabinet on two stubby feet, with a grid of jack sockets and two draped patch cords plugged across it.
new.focal: The draped patch cords bridging sockets

new.name: MMIO Pigeonhole
new.depicts: A wall-mounted brass-framed pigeonhole cubby box with four slot openings, two holding protruding metal key-cards.
new.focal: The protruding key-cards in the slots

new.name: MSI-X Tapper
new.depicts: A small desk-mounted brass telegraph tapper on a plinth with a rounded knob and a spring-loaded contact arm.

new.name: Hot-Plug Latch
new.depicts: A compact card-edge ejector latch mounted on a short bracket, with a hooked lever arm and a tiny status pip on the pivot.

new.name: Credit Clicker
new.depicts: A handheld mechanical tally clicker resting on a flat base, with a thumb-press plunger on top and a 3-digit drum window on the front.

new.name: TLP Capsule
new.depicts: A cylindrical brass-capped pneumatic dispatch capsule resting on a cradle stand, with a band collar around its middle.
new.focal: The brass-capped cylinder in its cradle
